## <img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74038190/214644152-52f47eb3-5e31-4f47-8758-05c9468d5596.gif" width="34" /> `whoami`

<img align="right" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74038190/229223263-cf2e4b07-2615-4f87-9c38-e37600f8381a.gif" width="340" alt="Developer at work" />

I'm **Devvarth**, a full-stack engineer from 🇮🇳 India who builds **AI-native products** end to end, from the database schema to the agent loop to the pixels.

- 🤖 I build **agentic apps**: AI that writes, runs and ships code inside cloud sandboxes (**Daytona**, **E2B**)
- ⚡ My stack is type-safe from end to end: **Next.js 16 · React 19 · tRPC · Drizzle · Neon Postgres**
- 🎙️ I've shipped **realtime voice agents** that join live video calls using OpenAI Realtime
- 📊 I'm a data mining nerd: I've crunched **2.2M+ research papers** to find what's trending in science
- 🌱 Right now I'm going deeper on **MCP servers, multi-agent orchestration, RAG and LLM evals**
- 💬 Ask me about **React, Node, AI agents and durable workflows**
- 📫 You can reach me at **[devvarthsinghwork@gmail.com](mailto:devvarthsinghwork@gmail.com)**

<br clear="right" />

```ts
// agent.config.ts
const devvarth = new Agent({
  name: "Devvarth Singh",
  model: "caffeine-4o",                          // runs on chai ☕
  tools: [nextjs, trpc, drizzle, aiSdk, daytona, mcp],
  memory: "every bug I've ever fixed",
  goal: "ship things people actually use",
});

await devvarth.run("build something amazing");   // ✅ streaming...
```

## 🧠 AI Arsenal

<img align="right" src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74038190/221352989-518609ab-b4d1-459e-929f-a08cd2bd9b3c.gif" width="230" alt="Friendly robot" />

> I don't just call an API. I build the whole loop: **tools, sandboxes, memory, retries, streaming UI**.

- 🛠️ **Tool-calling agents** that read and write files and run terminal commands
- 🧪 **Isolated code execution** in E2B and Daytona cloud sandboxes
- 🔁 **Durable agent runs** that survive crashes, with Inngest and Trigger.dev
- 🎙️ **Realtime voice agents** that join live calls through OpenAI Realtime
- 📚 **RAG pipelines** with embeddings, pgvector and semantic search
- 🔌 **MCP servers** that plug custom tools into any LLM client
